what: Ranking: a top N counting down; each number slams in as an outline that fills, label and note follow, a vertical whip with real blur carries to the next; number one in the accent
title: Five tricks that keep you scrolling
intent: Hold the viewer to the end with an open loop: what is number one?
action: Each place gets the same share of time: the number slams in huge, outline first then filled, the label rises, a short note follows; a vertical whip with real motion blur carries to the next place; countdown dots on the side; number one lands in red and holds
make_it_yours: Edit data.json: the title and up to ten items from the last place to number one (rank, label, note). Give it about 1.5–2 s per place plus 2.5 s for number one.
craft_note: The countdown is an open loop: the dots show what is left so the viewer stays for number one. Put the strongest item last and a surprising one first.
look: Bold editorial on paper: black numbers, one red number one
